pill.desc: sterile injection in single-dose and multiple-dose vials

tell: Only 0.3% of a dose is excreted unchanged; it is glucuronidated rather than oxidized, so liver disease barely alters clearance.

clues.text: Completely and rapidly absorbed after intramuscular injection, and about 91% bound to plasma proteins. It is conjugated in the liver, and its inactive conjugate is eliminated mainly by the kidneys.
Molecular weight 321.16. It is a powder that is almost insoluble in water.
An NDA product as injection in 2 mg/mL and 4 mg/mL strengths, in single-dose and multiple-dose vials.
Boxed warning on concomitant opioid use, abuse and dependence. Contraindicated in acute narrow-angle glaucoma and sleep apnea syndrome; somnolence and hypotension are common.
Treatment of status epilepticus, and preanesthetic use in adults for sedation, relief of anxiety and reduced recall of the day of surgery.
It has antianxiety, sedative and anticonvulsant effects; the label gives no molecular mechanism.
The generic name begins with L and has nine letters.
